_comment: Non-league competitions. The field is every club of the named tiers that exists in the database; early amateur rounds outside the snapshot are not modelled. Round names and legs are derived from the field size: the last three rounds are quarter-final, semi and final, and `two_legged` names the rounds played over two legs. Starts are the first round the snapshot clubs can play, not the amateur preliminary date. Super cups take last season's league and cup winners from the career history and are skipped in the first season.

ESCUP.label: Copa del Rey
ESCUP.note: 126 clubs in the real 2025-26 edition; the field here is the Spanish clubs present in the snapshot. The four Supercopa clubs' round-of-32 entry and the two-legged preliminary round are not modelled separately.

ENGFA.label: FA Cup
ENGFA.note: 124 clubs in the real first round proper; the field here is the 92 English clubs of tiers 1-4. Premier League and Championship clubs' third-round entry and the qualifying rounds are not modelled.

ENGLC.label: EFL Cup
ENGLC.note: The start is the league start; the 4-club preliminary round is not modelled. Semi-finals are the only two-legged round.

GERPOK.label: DFB-Pokal
GERPOK.note: 64 clubs in the real edition; the field here is the 56 German clubs of tiers 1-3. The regional cup winners' slots are not modelled.

ITACOP.label: Coppa Italia
ITACOP.note: 44 clubs in the real edition (20 Serie A, 20 Serie B, 4 Serie C); the field here is the 40 clubs of tiers 1-2. The top eight Serie A clubs' round-of-16 entry is not modelled separately.

FRACOP.label: Coupe de France
FRACOP.note: The real competition opens in May at regional level and the 18 Ligue 1 clubs enter at the round of 64. The start here is a proxy for the first round the snapshot clubs play; amateur rounds are not modelled.

ESPSC.label: Supercopa de España
ESPSC.note: League winners and runners-up plus cup winners and runners-up; the next league club fills an overlap. Installed from the second career season.

ENGCS.label: FA Community Shield
ENGCS.note: League champions vs FA Cup winners; the league runner-up fills an overlap. The start is the league boundary, because the career calendar opens there.

GERSC.label: DFL-Supercup
GERSC.note: League champions vs DFB-Pokal winners; the league runner-up fills an overlap.

ITASC.label: Supercoppa Italiana
ITASC.note: League winners and runners-up plus cup winners and runners-up; the next league club fills an overlap.

FRASC.label: Trophée des Champions
FRASC.note: League champions vs Coupe de France winners; the league runner-up fills an overlap.

NETHERLANDSCUP.label: KNVB Cup
NETHERLANDSCUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

MEXICOCUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

USACUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

JAPANCUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

CHINACUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

EGYPTCUP.label: Egypt Cup
EGYPTCUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SAUDIARABIACUP.label: King's Cup
SAUDIARABIACUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

AUSTRALIACUP.label: Australia Cup
AUSTRALIACUP.note: Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ALBANIACUP.label: Kupa e Shqipërisë
ALBANIACUP.note: 42 teams; final 13 May 2026. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ANDORRACUP.label: Copa Constitució
ANDORRACUP.note: Calendar-year season; first round 11 Jan, final 23 May 2026. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ARMENIACUP.label: Armenian Cup (Hayastani Ankakhutyan Gavath)
ARMENIACUP.note: Each QF and SF tie is listed with two match dates a month apart (QF 3–5 Mar + 1–2 Apr, SF 15–16 Apr + 29 Apr), i.e. two legs; the page does not label the legs explicitly. Final traditionally on 9 May, here 14 May 2026. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

AUSTRIACUP.label: ÖFB-Cup
AUSTRIACUP.note: Final 1 May 2026 at Wörthersee Stadion, Klagenfurt (neutral). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

AZERBAIJANCUP.label: Azərbaycan Kuboku
AZERBAIJANCUP.note: Quarter-finals and semi-finals are played over two legs (match boxes carry 'First leg' and an aggregate score); all earlier rounds single. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

BELARUSCUP.label: Kubak Belarusi
BELARUSCUP.note: The infobox gives 3 May 2025 as the start, the prose 3 April 2025 (first-round draw 23 April) - start month uncertain by one month. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

BELGIUMCUP.label: Croky Cup (Beker van België)
BELGIUMCUP.note: Season page says only 'qualify for the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League'; the round (play-off) comes from the 2026-27 access list. Final at King Baudouin Stadium, Brussels. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

BULGARIACUP.label: Kupa na Bũlgariya
BULGARIACUP.note: Semi-finals over first and second legs; everything else one-legged. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

CROATIACUP.label: Hrvatski nogometni kup (SuperSport HNK)
CROATIACUP.note: All 2025-26 rounds are single matches: the calendar lists one date per round and 4 QF / 2 SF fixtures. Historically the QF and SF were two-legged - do not carry that assumption over. Final 13 May 2026 at Opus Arena, Osijek (host chosen in advance). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

CYPRUSCUP.label: Kypriako Kypello (Cypriot Cup)
CYPRUSCUP.note: Season page says the winner enters 'the first qualifying round of the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League'; the 2026-27 access list puts Cyprus (rank 19) in the second qualifying round - both are cited, the access list is used here. Final at GSP Stadium, Nicosia (29 May 2026). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

CZECHREPUBLICCUP.label: MOL Cup (Pohár FAČR)
CZECHREPUBLICCUP.note: Season page names the competition but not the round; play-off round comes from the 2026-27 access list (Czech Republic rank 9). Cup winner Karviná was later disqualified for match-fixing, so the berth cascaded. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

DENMARKCUP.label: Oddset Pokalen (DBU Pokalen)
DENMARKCUP.note: Both QF and SF are two-legged; final 14 May 2026 at Parken Stadium, Copenhagen. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ESTONIACUP.label: Eesti Karikas (Estonian Cup)
ESTONIACUP.note: Season page names no European round for the winner; Conference League Q1 comes from the 2026-27 access list (Estonia rank 45). Final 23 May 2026. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

FAROEISLANDSCUP.label: Løgmanssteypið
FAROEISLANDSCUP.note: Only the semis are two-legged; the final is played on 31 October 2025 at Tórsvøllur (long gap after the June semis). Berth round from the 2026-27 access list (rank 40). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

FINLANDCUP.label: Suomen Cup (Finnish Cup)
FINLANDCUP.note: 400+ entrants, 10 rounds in a calendar-year season. Season page names no European round; Conference League Q2 from the 2026-27 access list (rank 38). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

GEORGIACUP.label: Sakartvelos Tasi (Davit Kipiani Cup)
GEORGIACUP.note: Calendar-year season: 4 May - 10 December 2025. Access list puts Georgia (rank 50) in Conference League Q1. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

GIBRALTARCUP.label: Rock Cup
GIBRALTARCUP.note: Very short window (31 Jan - 14 Mar 2026), played at Europa Point Stadium. Berth round from the 2026-27 access list (Gibraltar rank 54). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

GREECECUP.label: Kypello Elladas (Betsson Greek Cup)
GREECECUP.note: New-format season: single qualifying round, then a 5-matchday league phase (top 4 to the QF, 5th-12th to one-legged play-offs), then QF one leg, SF two legs. Season page says only 'Europa League'; play-off round from the 2026-27 access list (Greece rank 12). Final 25 April 2026 at Panthessaliko Stadium, Volos. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

HUNGARYCUP.label: MOL Magyar Kupa
HUNGARYCUP.note: 8 rounds, 2 August 2025 - 9 May 2026, final at Puskás Aréna. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ICELANDCUP.label: Bikarkeppni karla (Icelandic Cup)
ICELANDCUP.note: Calendar-year, 28 Mar - 22 Aug 2025, final at Laugardalsvöllur. Season page names no European round; Europa League Q1 from the 2026-27 access list (Iceland rank 33). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ISRAELCUP.label: Gvia HaMedina (Israel State Cup)
ISRAELCUP.note: Season page states no European round; Europa League Q2 from the 2026-27 access list (Israel rank 18). Final 26 May 2026 at Teddy Stadium, Jerusalem. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

KAZAKHSTANCUP.label: Kazakhstan Cup
KAZAKHSTANCUP.note: Calendar-year: prelim 15 Mar, R16 12-13 Apr, QF 14 May, SF two legs (25 Jun / 30 Aug), final 4 Oct 2025. Berth round from the 2026-27 access list (rank 39). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

KOSOVOCUP.label: Kupa e Kosovës
KOSOVOCUP.note: Round of 32 3-5 Dec 2025, R16 Feb, QF Mar, SF two-legged (8/22 Apr), final 21 May 2026. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

LATVIACUP.label: Latvijas Kauss
LATVIACUP.note: Calendar-year, every round single-legged, final 29 October 2025 at Skonto Stadium, Riga. Season page says only 'Conference League'; Q2 from the 2026-27 access list (Latvia rank 36). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

LITHUANIACUP.label: Lithuanian Football Cup (LFF Taurė)
LITHUANIACUP.note: Calendar-year season (Apr-Sep). Final is a single match at a neutral ground (2025: Central Stadium of Jonava). Winner also enters the Lithuanian Supercup. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

LUXEMBOURGCUP.label: Luxembourg Cup (Coupe de Luxembourg)
LUXEMBOURGCUP.note: Single final at the Stade de Luxembourg (neutral). Rounds: preliminary, 1st, 2nd, round of 32, round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, final. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

MALTACUP.label: Maltese FA Trophy
MALTACUP.note: Infobox gives 6 December 2025 – 24 May 2026; the 2026 final match box is dated 23 May 2026. Single final at the National Stadium, Ta' Qali. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

MOLDOVACUP.label: Moldovan Cup (Cupa Moldovei)
MOLDOVACUP.note: Single final at the Zimbru Stadium, Chișinău. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

MONTENEGROCUP.label: Montenegrin Cup
MONTENEGROCUP.note: 16 clubs, the round of 16 drawn in mid-October is the first round. (The infobox match count of 17 does not match a plain 16-team bracket.) Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

NORTHMACEDONIACUP.label: Macedonian Football Cup
NORTHMACEDONIACUP.note: Dates from the infobox (26 August 2025 – 20 May 2026). The cup article states no European round; it follows the UEFA access list (low-ranked association, Conference League qualifying). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

NORTHERNIRELANDCUP.label: Irish Cup
NORTHERNIRELANDCUP.note: Replays abolished from the whole competition in 2014; level ties go to extra time and penalties. Both semi-finals and the final are usually at Windsor Park. Berth passes to the 3rd-placed league club if the winner is already qualified or unlicensed. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

NORWAYCUP.label: Norwegian Football Cup (NM Cupen)
NORWAYCUP.note: 2025-26 was the first season of the new autumn-spring format (previously a calendar-year cup ending in Nov/Dec). Transitional entry: Eliteserien clubs joined at the third round, and the winner was due to play a Europa League play-off against the 2025 cup winner (cancelled as Bodø/Glimt won both). Final at Ullevaal Stadion. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

POLANDCUP.label: Polish Cup (Puchar Polski)
POLANDCUP.note: Every tie is a single game at the lower-league club's ground; the final is a single match at the Stadion Narodowy since 2007 (two-legged finals were 2002-2006 only). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

IRELANDCUP.label: FAI Cup
IRELANDCUP.note: Calendar-year season; first round in May, single final in November (Aviva Stadium). Rounds decided on the day by extra time and penalties. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ROMANIACUP.label: Cupa României
ROMANIACUP.note: Group stage = four groups (A-D) with the top two reaching the quarter-finals; in 2025-26 the quarter-finals and semi-finals were single legs, but the FRF may choose two legs for round of 16/quarter/semi in other years. Single final at a pre-established venue (normally Bucharest). Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

RUSSIACUP.label: Russian Cup
RUSSIACUP.note: The final is a single match marketed as the 'Superfinal' (2026: Luzhniki, 24 May). Earlier editions (2010-11) used a two-legged final; not current. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SANMARINOCUP.label: Coppa Titano
SANMARINOCUP.note: Only the final is a single match (23 May 2026, San Marino Stadium, Serravalle); the three earlier rounds are two-legged. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SCOTLANDCUP.label: Scottish Cup
SCOTLANDCUP.note: Dates from the season infobox and SFA calendar (preliminary round one 9 Aug 2025, final 23 May 2026 at Hampden Park). All ties decided on the day (extra time/penalties); no replays. The Scottish League Cup is the second cup and is covered in league-cups.json. The cup article does not state the European round — play-off round follows from Scotland's association ranking in the UEFA access list. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SERBIACUP.label: Serbian Cup (Kup Srbije)
SERBIACUP.note: Single final at a neutral ground (2026: Lagator Stadium, Loznica). Berth wording is the cup article's own ('a spot in the UEFA Europa League qualifying round'); the exact round follows the UEFA access list. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SLOVAKIACUP.label: Slovak Cup (Slovnaft Cup)
SLOVAKIACUP.note: Dates from the infobox (18 July 2025 – 1 May 2026). Single final. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SLOVENIACUP.label: Slovenian Football Cup (Pokal Slovenije)
SLOVENIACUP.note: No dates in the infobox. Earliest regional preliminary match listed is 9 August 2025; the national round of 32 was 21-30 October 2025; final 13 May 2026. Berth wording is competition-level only — the cup article states no round. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SWEDENCUP.label: Svenska Cupen
SWEDENCUP.note: Window spans 12 months: 7 May 2025 (first knockout rounds) to 14 May 2026 (final); group stage Feb-Mar 2026, quarter-finals/semi-finals/final in spring. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

SWITZERLANDCUP.label: Swiss Cup (Schweizer Cup)
SWITZERLANDCUP.note: Single final at the Wankdorf, Bern. The cup article states no European round; competition-level berth only. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

UKRAINECUP.label: Ukrainian Cup
UKRAINECUP.note: Infobox gives 8 August 2025 (qualification round 8-10 August). Single final in Lviv (neutral); wartime venue restrictions apply to eastern clubs. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

WALESCUP.label: Welsh Cup (JD Welsh Cup)
WALESCUP.note: First qualifying round ties on 25-27 July 2025; final 12 April 2026 at Rodney Parade, Newport (neutral). Round structure: 1st/2nd qualifying, 1st/2nd/3rd/4th round, quarter-finals, semi-finals, final. Welsh clubs playing in the English pyramid are excluded. The Welsh League Cup is the second cup and is covered in league-cups.json. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

REPUBLICOFIRELANDCUP.label: FAI Cup
REPUBLICOFIRELANDCUP.note: Calendar-year season; first round in May, single final in November (Aviva Stadium). Rounds decided on the day by extra time and penalties. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

BOSNIAANDHERZEGOVINACUP.label: Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup
BOSNIAANDHERZEGOVINACUP.note: 32 clubs; quarter-finals, semi-finals and final are two-legged. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

LIECHTENSTEINCUP.label: Liechtenstein Cup
LIECHTENSTEINCUP.note: Seven senior clubs (reserve teams excluded); single-leg knockout. Group phases, replays and early amateur rounds are not modelled.

ALGECUP.label: Algerian Cup
ALGECUP.note: Final is a single match at a national stadium (Nelson Mandela Stadium, Algiers in 2025 and 2026); no two-legged final in the current format.

ETHICUP.label: Ethiopian Cup
ETHICUP.note: No season articles exist on Wikipedia, and no round dates are published; only the final result is recorded (RSSSF page last updated 26 Jul 2026, so the 2025-26 final was played before late July). Format/berth inferred from the standard Ethiopian pattern, not sourced.

GHANFACUP.label: Ghana FA Cup
GHANFACUP.note: Berth not printed in the season article; taken from the standard Ghanaian cup-winner slot.

LIBYCUP.label: Libyan Cup
LIBYCUP.note: 2023-24 edition was not played; the 2025 and 2026 finals were staged abroad in Cairo. No round dates published anywhere checked, so the window is left null.

THROCUP.label: Throne Cup
THROCUP.note: Window is irregular: the 2023-24 edition played its quarter-finals on 14-15 June 2025, so a fixed annual window cannot be stated. Some rounds were two-legged in earlier periods; the current format is one-legged with a single final, usually at the Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium in Rabat.

NIGEFEDECUP.label: Nigeria Federation Cup
NIGEFEDECUP.note: All matches are played at neutral venues; replays existed historically (1968, 1972 finals) but not in the current format.

COUPDUSENE.label: Coupe du Senegal
COUPDUSENE.note: Penalties decide drawn matches from the round of 32; extra time only from the semi-finals. The draw was on 16 January 2026 but the source gives no round dates, so no window is stated.

NEDBCUP.label: Nedbank Cup
NEDBCUP.note: No replays: drawn matches go to extra time and penalties. Final is a single match at a neutral venue.

TUNICUP.label: Tunisian Cup
TUNICUP.note: Window is from the last completed edition (2024-25); the 2025-26 edition ran into 2026 with the round-of-16 draw on 27 February 2026. Final is a single match; two-legged finals appear only in older editions.

UGANCUP.label: Uganda Cup
UGANCUP.note: No season articles exist for recent editions and no round calendar is published; only the fact that recent finals were played in June (12 June 2022, Masindi) is documented. Format assumed single-leg knockout.

COPABOLI.label: Copa Bolivia
COPABOLI.note: Two-legged final, no neutral venue. The group phase is eight matchdays with clubs crossing groups, so it is not a clean round-robin per group.

CANACHAM.label: Canadian Championship
CANACHAM.note: Preliminary round and final are single matches; only the middle two rounds are two-legged.

COPACHIL.label: Copa Chile
COPACHIL.note: Window from 2025 (26 Jan - 10 Dec); 2026 started 30 Jan and its closing date was still unset when checked. Single neutral final; older editions had a two-legged final.

COPACOLO.label: Copa Colombia
COPACOLO.note: 2026 exception: after the Colombia earthquake Dimayor made the round of 16 and quarter-finals single-leg. The default (2025 and earlier) is two legs in every knockout round including the final. Window from 2025 (28 May - 17 Dec); 2026 ran May - December.

TORNDECOPA.label: Torneo de Copa
TORNDECOPA.note: Runs across the split season: opens in the Apertura (late July) and closes in April of the next calendar year. The LINAFA preliminary round is single-leg; the semi-final leg count is not stated in the source.

COPAECUA.label: Copa Ecuador
COPAECUA.note: Every round is a single match except the semi-finals; the final is one match at a neutral venue (Estadio Alejandro Serrano Aguilar, Cuenca in 2026).

JFFCHAMCUP.label: JFF Champions Cup / Lynk Cup
JFFCHAMCUP.note: Window from the 2023 edition (kick-off 21 Mar, final 26 May at Sabina Park, Kingston). The competition is a single calendar-year spring knockout, not a season-long cup; no season article with full dates exists.

COPAPRIM.label: Copa Primera
COPAPRIM.note: Two legs in every round including the final, no neutral final. Played inside the split Apertura/Clausura season; the Wikipedia articles carry no per-season dates, so no window is given.

TORNDECOPA2.label: Torneo de Copa
TORNDECOPA2.note: One edition per Apertura of the split season (2015-2021), so it is a half-season cup, not a full-year one. Dormant 2022-2025 and revived for 2026 as the Copa Rommel Fernández; no round dates are published on Wikipedia for any edition.

COPAPARA.label: Copa Paraguay
COPAPARA.note: Single-leg throughout, ties level after 90 minutes go straight to penalties, final one match at a neutral ground (Estadio La Huerta, Asunción in 2026).

COPABICE.label: Copa Bicentenario
COPABICE.note: Defunct: only two editions (2019, 2021); the FPF announced in 2023 that it would not run again and promised a new national cup from 2024 with a Libertadores berth, but no such competition is documented. It began in June, after the Liga1 Apertura, which is why no end date is given.

COPALUISVILL.label: Copa Luis Villarejo
COPALUISVILL.note: Window from 2019; the 2026 edition ran 10 Jan - 12 Apr, i.e. the cup sits in the first half of the calendar year inside the split season. Not held every year (2017 cancelled after hurricane Maria, 2018 skipped).

COPAAUFURUG.label: Copa AUF Uruguay
COPAAUFURUG.note: Every knockout round is one match; both semi-finals and the final are at neutral venues. Start is exact (25 Aug, infobox); the closing date is only given as ''noviembre''.

COPAVENE.label: Copa Venezuela
COPAVENE.note: Format changed in 2026 (previously a straight knockout). Every knockout tie is one match at the drawn home side, so there is no neutral final.

HUNSENCUP.label: Hun Sen Cup
HUNSENCUP.note: National stage play-offs start 21 December 2025, round of 16 first legs 21 January 2026; single final on 24 May 2026 at Morodok Techo National Stadium. No AFC berth mentioned in the season article.

TAIWPRESFA.label: Taiwan President FA Cup
TAIWPRESFA.note: Four groups of five, then quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. The article has no prose format section; both the dates and the AFC Challenge League berth come from the infobox.

HONGKONGFA.label: Hong Kong FA Cup
HONGKONGFA.note: Preliminary round 20-21 December 2025 with 4 clubs, 6 clubs byed to the quarter-finals (7-8 March), semis 23-24 May, final 30 May 2026.

AIFFSUPECUP.label: AIFF Super Cup
AIFFSUPECUP.note: Played as a short one-venue tournament inside the ISL season. The 2025 edition (20 April – 3 May 2025, 15 clubs, one bye to the quarter-finals) was the same family. The Durand Cup is a separate invitational run by the Army, not the AIFF national cup.

PIALINDO.label: Piala Indonesia
PIALINDO.note: Suspended after 2018-19; PSSI cited geography and calendar congestion in July 2025 (Antara headline above). Do not schedule a Piala Indonesia until a new edition is announced.

HAZFCUP.label: Hazfi Cup
HAZFCUP.note: The 2025-26 infobox has no dates (first-round draw 10 September 2025); the window is taken from 2024-25, whose infobox reads '29 September 2024 – 29 May 2025' (78 clubs).

IRAQFACUP.label: Iraq FA Cup
IRAQFACUP.note: Abandoned: the round-of-16 draw was held on 18 May 2026 and the Iraq FA cancelled the tournament on 27 May 2026 because of a clash with the national team. No winner, no berth.

JORDFACUP.label: Jordan FA Cup
JORDFACUP.note: Preliminary round 15 June 2025, round of 32 6 October 2025, semis 12 May 2026. The final's date template reads 2025-05-16, a year typo for 2026.

LEBAFACUP.label: Lebanese FA Cup
LEBAFACUP.note: Round of 16 16-22 November 2025, quarter-finals 17-18 January 2026, semis 11 February 2026, final 8 July 2026 (pushed back by the March-May 2026 war suspension). No continental berth is stated in the season article.

MALAFACUP.label: Malaysia FA Cup
MALAFACUP.note: 2025 was a format change: round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals two-legged, single final (14 December 2025).

GENEAUNGSAN.label: General Aung San Shield
GENEAUNGSAN.note: No season article with dates; 22 teams and the two qualifying competitions come from the competition infobox. Berth round not stated.

SULTQABOCUP.label: Sultan Qaboos Cup
SULTQABOCUP.note: Competition infobox lists 32 teams and Al-Nahda as 2025-26 champion, but no season article (and no dates) exists; berth not verified.

COPAPAULALCA.label: Copa Paulino Alcantara
COPAPAULALCA.note: Format quote: 'The quarterfinals and semifinals would be two-legged, marking a difference from the previous editions, while the final would be held over a single match.' 2023 is the last edition found; the cup is not played every year, so do not assume an annual slot.

AMIRCUP.label: Amir Cup
AMIRCUP.note: Short window at the end of the season (21 April - 24 May 2025), not a season-long cup. A separate curtain-raiser (Sheikh Jassim Cup / Qatar Super Cup) exists but was not verified.

SINGCUP.label: Singapore Cup
SINGCUP.note: New format for 2025-26: one group stage, then two-legged semis and a single final, all inside a 10-week November-January window.

THAIFACUP.label: Thai FA Cup
THAIFACUP.note: Full-season cup with a qualification round; the berth is the strongest in this set (Elite, not Two).

UAEPRESS.label: UAE President's Cup
UAEPRESS.note: No 2025-26 season article was found; the 2024-25 edition is the reference. Preliminary/play-off rounds thin the 30 entrants before the round of 16.

UZBECUP.label: Uzbekistan Cup
UZBECUP.note: Starts in February, before the league, and runs the whole calendar year.

VIETNATICUP.label: Vietnamese National Cup
VIETNATICUP.note: No AFC berth: the cup winner goes to the ASEAN Club Championship, the league places go to AFC competitions.

CHATCUP.label: Chatham Cup
CHATCUP.note: This is the national cup. 122 entrants, four knockout rounds before the National League clubs join; the winner gets no continental place.

IRANSUP.label: Iranian Super Cup
IRANSUP.note: super cup from the research; date from the source

IRAQSUP.label: Iraqi Super Cup
IRAQSUP.note: super cup from the research; date from the source

THAISUP.label: Thailand Champions Cup
THAISUP.note: super cup from the research; date from the source

UZBESUP.label: Uzbekistan Super Cup
